text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash was gifted some tickets to an amusement park, so the two of us decide to visit it after a day out.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Amusement parks look so different in the evening. The attractions are a magical sight to behold, illuminated in neon lights…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I think we'll have fun here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, we have limited time, so let's follow this timetable I made and visit each attraction in order. I made it as detailed as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first thing on Eishin Flash's schedule is a roller coaster.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: At this pace, we shall reach maximum altitude in precisely seven seconds. Then we shall plummet at an incredible velocity.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Five, four, three, two…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh—zero!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We go on all sorts of rides after that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There, that's it for the spinning teacups and Ferris wheel. Next is the tower drop ride—
choice_data_list: What about the haunted house over there?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …That is not on the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because there may be… zombies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, we have a great time while following her timetable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we look around the gift shop? I must buy a souvenir for Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's the store. Let's make our purchases by 7:20 p.m. and leave the premises by 7:30 p.m.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With these times in mind, we head to the shop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh… They are hosting a German fair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We had no idea there was an event going on, but it seems the gift shop and kiosks are selling things from Germany today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah… They have Donauwelle.
choice_data_list: Is it a German pastry too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. "Welle" means "wave," as in the waves of water… Do you see how the chocolate appears like small waves?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's very good. I recommend it. Though, as the daughter of patissiers, I may need to check the taste for authenticity…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could those be Streuselkuchen and Lebkuchen?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wow… They have such variety, and nothing appears factory-made. Perhaps these were all handmade by true meisters…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen to catch a glimpse of my watch. It's already 7:20 p.m.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh! Have a look! This is called a Hummel doll.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There's one inside my parent's shop too. It's been there since I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was a little girl doll with a baby sheep. We kept it on the shelf directly to the left of the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ahh… What fond memories. I was once scolded for playing with that doll when I was quite young… Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I never imagined I would be given an opportunity to recall my homeland on a day like today. How—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm? That sound…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh no! What's the time?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My most sincere apologies! I've ruined our schedule because of my mindless daydreaming!
choice_data_list: It's okay. That's the right thing to do today.
It's okay. That's the right thing to do today.
Since we're here, why don't we look around some more?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My most sincere apologies! I've ruined our schedule because of my mindless daydreaming!
choice_data_list: It's okay. That's the right thing to do today.
It's okay. That's the right thing to do today.
Since we're here, why don't we look around some more?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well… yes. Reliving moments of my childhood has been quite fun.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But to become so lost in thought as to derail our schedule… I still have much to learn about being disciplined…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind. Moving forward, I shall include more leeway into my timetables.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Therefore, it won't be an issue even if I have so much fun that I lose track of time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I want to enjoy myself to the fullest when I get a chance like this again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We mustn't! If we do, the schedule will be in complete ruins!
choice_data_list: But isn't it nice to be here? Think of this as a happy accident.
But isn't it nice to be here? Think of this as a happy accident.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A happy accident?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I suppose it is important for schedules to be fluid in order to accommodate unexpected circumstances and accidents, happy or not…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well. I'll adjust the timetable so we can take our time browsing for souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'll take this moment to lose myself in memories of home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Eishin Flash and I go home with our arms full of souvenirs.
